# gitmoap_repository_members (Data Source)

List repository members. The people with a direct role on the repository, newest first, at most 100 per page; `search` narrows them by username or email. A repository's roster is not public, even when the repository is: the caller must be signed in and able to see who has access here (Reporters and above with the built-in roles).

The token needs `repo_member:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_members" "api" {
  repo_id = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Optional

- `search` (String) Autocomplete fragment — substring match on the member's username or email

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `access_level` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `group_id` (String)
- `repository_id` (String)
- `user_id` (String)
- `visibility` (String)
